# National Spine Management Group (NSMG)

> Leaders in Academic Spinal Care. The complete system for spine-focused chiropractic practice: clinical training, documentation that holds up to scrutiny, and referral relationships with attorneys and physicians, taught as one system by National Spine Management Group.

NSMG offers two post-doctoral programs for doctors of chiropractic. Members sign in to the NSMG Member Portal for courses, enrollment and purchases.

## Programs

- [Advanced Imaging Certification](https://www.nationalspinemanagement.com/advanced-imaging-certification/): The Spine Management Pathway, an 18-module MRI curriculum for doctors of chiropractic built on case-based DICOM review, developed by NSMG in collaboration with Medality™. 276 CE hours across three six-module courses (Course I: Spine & Spinal Lesions, 87 hours; Course II: Emergency & Brain Neuroimaging, 92 hours; Course III: Neurovascular & Musculoskeletal, 97 hours). Each module combines didactic lecture with DICOM review, a research review with a 350-word summary, and 5 MRI case submissions (90 cases in total). Approved for continuing education through the FCLB PACE program; NSMG is an FCLB PACE provider. Take all 18 modules at once or one course at a time.
- [Fellowship in Spine Management](https://www.nationalspinemanagement.com/fellowship-in-spine-management/): A two-year post-doctoral fellowship. Year One is the Advanced Imaging Certification; Year Two is six interprofessional clinical rotations (Interventional Pain Management; MRI Physics & Neuroradiology; Orthopedic Extremity & Spine Surgery; Neurosurgery & Emergency Medicine; Family & Internal Medicine; Spine-Care Team Integration capstone), each one on-site day per week for six weeks, coordinated within the fellow's own community with the help of NSMG, with 30+ peer-reviewed articles per rotation. Credentials include a Fellowship Completion Certificate from NSMG and a qualification pathway toward FSBT Fellowship designation.

## About

- [William J. Owens Jr., DC, FSBT](https://www.nationalspinemanagement.com/about/): President & CEO of National Spine Management Group since 2020. 28 years treating spine injury in Buffalo; still practicing at Greater Buffalo Accident and Injury Chiropractic. Directs the Fellowship in Spine Management, the Spine Management Residency Program and the Advanced Imaging Certification. Adjunct faculty, Parker University MS in Interprofessional Spine Management; the only chiropractor to complete the Royal College of Physicians Certified Physician Educator Program. Medico-legal consulting and court testimony. Author of a 2026 peer-reviewed North American Spine Society Journal study and IEEE engineering-in-medicine papers. [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/william-owens-dc-fsbt-58a85719/).
